name: LunchSignal agent · 5 colleagues → LinkedIn insight → Featherless → agent e-mail → human when hot

nodes.name: Form sign-up
nodes.notes: Called by google/apps-script.gs on every Google Form response.

nodes.name: LinkedIn company
nodes.notes: ~$0.004 per company. Searched by name; the next step checks the website matches.

nodes.name: LinkedIn posts
nodes.notes: $1.50 / 1k posts. Engagement per post; commenters are not stored.

nodes.name: People & Culture roles
nodes.notes: Only job titles reach the LLM (buying committee as roles). Check the exact profileScraperMode value in the actor input.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ profileScraperMode: 'Short ($1.5 per 1k)', maxItems: 15, companies: $('Verify company match').first().json.company ? [$('Verify company match').first().json.company.linkedinUrl] : [], jobTitles: ['People', 'HR', 'Human Resources', 'Personal', 'Office Manager', 'Workplace', 'Feel Good', 'Talent'] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct', temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 1200, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: "You are a B2B analyst for Bella&Bona (office lunch delivery and catering, Berlin/Munich/NRW; tax-free lunch benefit up to EUR 7.67 per employee per workday). Use ONLY the facts given. Return ONLY JSON: {\"culture\": string, \"structure\": string, \"buying_committee\": string[] (roles, no names), \"angle\": string, \"interest_score\": integer 0-100, \"score_reasons\": string[], \"champion_email_subject\": string, \"champion_email_html\": string}. The champion e-mail goes to employees who themselves signed up asking for office lunch: thank them, say how many colleagues joined, give two sentences they can forward to their People team, offer a free tasting for the team, and end with: Reply STOP to never hear from us again. Write it in the language that fits the company (German for German companies)." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ domain: $json.domain, colleagues_signed_up: $json.colleagues, city: $json.city, linkedin_verified: $json.verified, company: $json.company, top_posts: $json.topPosts, people_roles: $json.roleTitles }) }] }) }}

nodes.name: Agent e-mails the sign-ups
nodes.notes: Recipients are the people who signed up (consent). BCC so nobody sees colleagues' addresses.

filters.q: in:inbox is:unread subject:"Office lunch for your team"

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct', temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 1200, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: "Classify a reply to our office-lunch e-mail. Return ONLY JSON: {\"label\": \"interested\"|\"question\"|\"not_interested\"|\"stop\", \"summary\": string}. STOP, unsubscribe, abmelden or any request not to be contacted is \"stop\"." }, { role: 'user', content: String($json.text || $json.snippet || '').slice(0, 4000) }] }) }}
